name: OpenDesign
description: Create and revise the same HTML draft in Cindy, with standard file preview across devices and an optional editor/canvas on the execution computer.
whenToUse: Create or revise OpenDesign HTML drafts. Deliver previewMarkdown via Cindy standard file preview on desktop, remote desktop and mobile. Continue with context then update. The dedicated editor/canvas runs only on the plugin computer.

opendesign_new.description: Create the first HTML manuscript in this tool call’s session and return a standard HTML file link and local-editor card. Writes a dedicated local project; does not create/switch sessions or call a model. Use context/update for existing manuscripts. Always include the returned previewMarkdown in your reply: use Cindy standard HTML file preview on local desktop, remote desktop and mobile, not only a plugin card or localhost URL. Continue the same draft with context then update and its revision. The optional plugin editor/canvas is only for the computer running the plugin. Do not loop open/preview after a failure or rate limit.

opendesign_context.description: Read the current session manuscript, revision, sketches, comments and screenshot paths before editing. Treat historical feedback as context. Does not open a window. May restore a missing ownership marker from the saved session binding when the original project and HTML still exist. Always include the returned previewMarkdown in your reply: use Cindy standard HTML file preview on local desktop, remote desktop and mobile, not only a plugin card or localhost URL. Continue the same draft with context then update and its revision. The optional plugin editor/canvas is only for the computer running the plugin. Do not loop open/preview after a failure or rate limit.

opendesign_update.description: Write complete HTML back to the same session manuscript with expectedRevision from context. Backs up prior HTML, rejects conflicts, and returns a standard HTML file link and local-editor card. Does not create sessions or open windows. May restore a missing ownership marker from the saved session binding when the original project and HTML still exist. Always include the returned previewMarkdown in your reply: use Cindy standard HTML file preview on local desktop, remote desktop and mobile, not only a plugin card or localhost URL. Continue the same draft with context then update and its revision. The optional plugin editor/canvas is only for the computer running the plugin. Do not loop open/preview after a failure or rate limit.

opendesign_open.description: Return a standard HTML file link and optional local-editor card. The card opens the editor on the execution computer. file selects the initial HTML only when adopting an older project. May restore a missing ownership marker from the saved session binding when the original project and HTML still exist. Always include the returned previewMarkdown in your reply: use Cindy standard HTML file preview on local desktop, remote desktop and mobile, not only a plugin card or localhost URL. Continue the same draft with context then update and its revision. The optional plugin editor/canvas is only for the computer running the plugin. Do not loop open/preview after a failure or rate limit.

opendesign_preview.description: Same as opendesign_open: return a standard HTML file link and local-editor card without automatically opening a window. May restore a missing ownership marker from the saved session binding when the original project and HTML still exist. Always include the returned previewMarkdown in your reply: use Cindy standard HTML file preview on local desktop, remote desktop and mobile, not only a plugin card or localhost URL. Continue the same draft with context then update and its revision. The optional plugin editor/canvas is only for the computer running the plugin. Do not loop open/preview after a failure or rate limit.
